title: [PERF] Latência de leitura acima de 1 ms — operações read/scan com performance sub-ótima

todos.title: Add min_key/max_key fields to Table struct
todos.description: Table currently lacks range metadata. Add min_key/max_key fields, populate them from BTreeMap first/last entries in Table::build(), and from MetaBlock when loading from SSTable path.

todos.title: Wire LsmConfig block_cache_size into GlobalBlockCache
todos.description: Engine::new_generic() currently hardcodes block_cache_size_mb: 64. Thread the LsmConfig.storage.block_cache_size_mb value through.

todos.title: Plumb block cache and bloom filter into version_set.get()
todos.description: Modify VersionSet.get() to use SstableReader with might_contain() (bloom filter) before reading blocks. Store Arc<GlobalBlockCache> in VersionSet for cache passthrough.

todos.title: Skip non-intersecting SSTables in scan_cf
todos.description: In scan_cf, before adding an SSTable iterator, check if query range intersects table's [min_key, max_key]. Skip non-intersecting tables.

todos.title: Verify MergeIterator uses BinaryHeap
todos.description: Confirm MergeIterator in iterators.rs uses BinaryHeap. Add a unit test if not already present.

todos.title: Remove unwrap() from critical read paths
todos.description: Audit get_cf, scan_cf, version_set.get, SstableReader methods for unwrap() calls. Replace with ? or proper error handling.

todos.title: Add read performance benchmarks
todos.description: Add new criterion benchmark functions to benches/read_bench.rs for: memtable read latency, SSTable hot cache latency, Bloom filter negative read latency, scan 1000 keys latency.

todos.title: Run lint, clippy, tests; fix regressions
todos.description: cargo clippy -- -D warnings, cargo test --all-features, fix regressions. Update .task-state.json to done.
